name: What should I do if my safety lights are flickering or not turning on consistently?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if my safety lights are flickering or not turning on consistently?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your safety lights are flickering or inconsistent, it often indicates a problem that needs attention. First, check the circuit breaker to ensure it hasn't tripped. If the issue persists, it could be due to loose wiring connections, a failing bulb or ballast, or a faulty sensor or switch. These issues require professional diagnosis to avoid further damage or electrical hazards. Contacting a qualified electrician is recommended to pinpoint the exact cause and perform the necessary repairs safely and effectively, restoring reliable operation to your lighting system.
